name: Starfield backdrop
description: A canvas backdrop of pulsing squares laid out on a grid, thickest toward both side edges and fading downward, with four faint rings behind them and a glow that swells around the pointer.

propDocs.accent: Colour of the squares. A colour or var(--token); the default follows the product tint.
propDocs.spark: Colour of the glow that lights squares near the pointer.
propDocs.line: Colour of the four faint rings.
propDocs.seed: Whole number that picks which squares exist and how they pulse. The same seed always gives the same sky.
propDocs.reach: How far from the pointer squares brighten and grow, in pixels.

fallback: With reduced motion the squares are drawn once at a steady brightness and the pointer boost is off.
